jobs.prompt: Create a concrete game-art STATE DESIGN BOARD for approval, not a runtime asset. Each panel is a full-width 2:1 landscape scene; stack panels vertically with thin dark gutters and very small state labels OUTSIDE the artwork. No game UI, buttons, footer, cursor or inventory. Match Ivy Yard's hand-painted pixel-storybook visual language: readable dark hand-drawn contours, broad grouped color shapes, restrained stepped brush texture, matte materials, deep blue-teal shadows and localized warm amber light. Crisp high resolution, not low-res pixel art, vector, photography or glossy 3D. First reference is target spatial geometry, last is Yard STYLE ONLY. Repeat exactly the SAME camera, furniture geometry, background, lighting and scale in all panels; ONLY named state changes. Objects physically rest on their support with correctly foreshortened footprint, contact shadow and appropriate foreground occlusion. Never paste inventory icons. Three panels: CLOSED, MENU INSIDE, MENU TAKEN. Tight camera crop around the existing lower wooden drawer in first reference, same four brass circular lock wheels and single handle. Show the whole drawer width, blue tiles at sides, preserve upper drawer. Slight downward view as reference; don't deepen furniture. First closed. Second open same as reference but a recognizable aged cream Big Top menu with red spine and roast goose cover from second reference lies FLAT lengthwise left-to-right on drawer floor, roughly 45 percent of internal width. Strong perspective foreshortening along depth, front edge properly behind drawer front lip, contact shadow. Visible lettering BIG TOP and MENU follows perspective. Third identical open drawer without menu or its shadow. All four brass discs stay blank in ALL panels (runtime symbols independent). Menu not upright and not balanced on front edge. Highest possible readable resolution.

bedroomRevision: Edit this five-state Ivy game art approval board. Preserve all five panels, camera, box, fabrics, lamps, lighting, petal positions and labels EXACTLY. Only correct the brass token in panels PETAL AND TOKEN and TOKEN ONLY: it is currently too front-facing/circular, appearing upright. Redraw it lying completely FLAT on the cream fabric box floor, same right-side contact center. Its visible circular face must project to a clearly FORESHORTENED ELLIPSE whose vertical dimension is about 55 percent of its horizontal dimension, with thin rim thickness at front, tight contact shadow beneath, spoon/ivy engraving sharing the SAME foreshortening. Identical token size/orientation/location in both panels. Do not alter any other object, panel or background. Retain matte painterly grouped textures and hand drawn dark contours; no vector or photorealism. This is a state comparison board only.
